mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (indicating monetary easing) compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate falls below 4.0%, it signals a tight labor market that supports corporate profit growth and consumer spending, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in 60% or more of instances where UNRATE < 4.0.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts (HOUST) and real consumption (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer demand, which drives corporate earnings growth and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: The interaction between HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict returns (Rank IC < 0.03) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-inflation regime (CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5%), a rising federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals aggressive monetary tightening that reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: In periods where CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5, FEDFUNDS rises and SPX 20-day returns are positive in > 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index (INDPRO) indicates expanding manufacturing activity, which supports corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO trend fails to predict returns (Rank IC < 0.03) over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When monthly payroll employment growth exceeds 150,000 jobs, it signals a robust labor market that boosts consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in 60% or more of instances where PAYEMS > 150000.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous expansion in GDP (GDPC1) and housing starts (HOUST) indicates broad-based economic strength, which drives corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: The joint effect of GDPC1 and HOUST on returns is not significant (Rank IC < 0.03) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year CPI inflation rate above 2.5% signals persistent inflation that may prompt the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in > 40% of instances where CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5.
